_comment: MPL TestServer commons bug-list.json (design 'Bug Configuration'): the
authoritative ledger of known bugs across the MPL Language_Servers, a 'bugs'
object keyed by bug id, each { description, ticketId }. A server declares
the ids it currently exhibits in its own bug-config.json (a flat array);
every such id MUST be defined here.

aws-kms-keyring-accepts-missing-kms-clie.description: CreateAwsKmsKeyring builds a keyring when no KMS client is given

aws-kms-keyring-accepts-reply-key-id-tha.description: AWS KMS keyring OnEncrypt accepts a GenerateDataKey or Encrypt reply whose KeyId is a raw key id or an alias ARN, not a key ARN

aws-kms-keyring-skips-alias-arn-provider.description: AWS KMS keyring OnDecrypt skips an aws-kms encrypted data key whose provider info is an alias ARN, instead of failing
